turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it.

You gave my son a zero, and I found out because he showed me his phone. What exactly is your basis?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski.
I didn't come to be thanked. Your basis, Hale. What do you have on Owen's essay, and who decided on the zero?
I have to say, I can tell you're an amazing mother. Owen is lucky to have someone fight for him like this.
Don't manage me, Hale. I asked who decided on the zero and what you based it on.
Honestly, I wish more parents cared as much as you do.
That's the third time you've talked about me instead of answering me. Fifteen minutes, Hale. Did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in, yes or no?
So I'm sure we can work this out together.

"Together." Okay. You've had four turns and I still don't have a document, a date, or a name.

I'm writing down that you haven't answered the question. Did you speak to Owen before you entered that zero?
